query:
UPDATE kb_subscription_deliveries
              SET disposition = $2,
                  rationale = $3,
                  confidence = $4,
                  decided_at = now(),
                  decided_by_event_id = $5,
                  decided_by_invocation_id = $6,
                  decided_by_profile_id = $7
            WHERE id = $1 AND disposition IS NULL
